as_written_in_papers.quote: Sanger sequencing identified the patient was heterozygous for c.560T>C p.(Leu187Pro) and c.809C>T p.(Thr270lle) variants of uncertain clinical significance in the LCAT gene.

cases.statement: One person: a 44-year-old Caucasian man with FLD, heterozygous for c.560T>C p.(Leu187Pro) and c.809C>T.

people.label: patient
people.zygosity_or_genotype: heterozygous; with c.560T>C p.(Leu187Pro) (presumed compound heterozygous; phase not shown)
people.key_phenotypes: Diagnosed with LCAT deficiency in late teens; no cholesterol esterification rate or LCAT activity; proteinuria from 2004 with biopsy features of LCAT deficiency; progressive renal failure (CKD stage 5) now on hemodialysis.

quotes.quote: Our patient is a 44-year-old Caucasian male diagnosed with LCAT deficiency in his late teens.
These showed no CER or LCAT activity, confirming FLD phenotype.
Sanger sequencing identified the patient was heterozygous for c.560T>C p.(Leu187Pro) and c.809C>T p.(Thr270lle) variants of uncertain clinical significance in the LCAT gene.
Proteinuria developed from 2004, and renal biopsy confirmed histological features of LCAT deficiency (Supplementary Figure S1).
By 2019, renal function worsened (creatinine 214 μmol/l; urine protein-to-creatinine ratio 481 mg/mmol).
Currently, he is listed for deceased donor kidney transplantation, and he commenced hemodialysis in the interim.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Absent LCAT activity and cholesterol esterification, proteinuria and renal biopsy features of LCAT deficiency, described by the authors as confirming the FLD phenotype. No testing of other genes is reported.

quotes.quote: These showed no CER or LCAT activity, confirming FLD phenotype.
Proteinuria developed from 2004, and renal biopsy confirmed histological features of LCAT deficiency (Supplementary Figure S1).
Electron microscopy showing irregularly thickened glomerular basement membrane and intramembranous and subendothelial electron-dense, rounded lamellar bodies.

Patients with FLD develop corneal opacification, hemolytic anemia, proteinuria, and lipid abnormalities including elevated triglycerides, reduced high density lipoprotein cholesterol, and increased unesterified cholesterol rich lipoprotein X (LpX).

segregation.statement: One sister is reported to have LCAT deficiency, but her genotype is not reported. The unaffected sister carries c.560T>C; whether she carries c.809C>T is not reported. Parents not reported.

quotes.quote: The patient has 2 sisters: one with LCAT deficiency, the other asymptomatic.
However, preliminary health screening found she carried the same LCAT variant (c.560T>C) as her brother, negating her ability to be a donor.
She had no stigmata of FLD, normal renal function, and no proteinuria.

in_trans.statement: The other allele is c.560T>C p.(Leu187Pro). Phase was not shown: parents were not tested. The unaffected sister carries c.560T>C, but her status for c.809C>T is not reported, so phase cannot be inferred from her.

functional.statement: No assay of the variant itself. Patient plasma showed no cholesterol esterification rate or LCAT activity (in-house assays).

quotes.quote: These showed no CER or LCAT activity, confirming FLD phenotype.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Predicted consequence from the batch HGVS: missense, p.(Thr270Ile). The paper describes FLD as impaired cholesterol esterification and HDL maturation; it does not discuss the mechanism of this variant.

quotes.quote: Familial lecithin-cholesterol acyltransferase (LCAT) deficiency (FLD) is a rare disorder of lipid metabolism causing decreased maturation of high density lipoprotein particles and impaired cholesterol esterification.

authors_classification.statement: The authors describe both variants as of uncertain clinical significance; criteria not stated.

quotes.quote: variants of uncertain clinical significance in the LCAT gene
Sanger sequencing identified the patient was heterozygous for c.560T>C p.(Leu187Pro) and c.809C>T p.(Thr270lle) variants of uncertain clinical significance in the LCAT gene.

concerns: The paper writes the protein as 'p.(Thr270lle)' with two lowercase L's instead of 'Ile'; this is a typo for Thr270Ile and agrees with the predicted p.(Thr270Ile).
Second LCAT variant in the same person: c.560T>C p.(Leu187Pro); phase not established.
Transcript not stated in the paper.
notes_for_panel: Single FLD patient with absent LCAT activity and end-stage renal disease; authors call both variants of uncertain clinical significance. The family has an affected sister (not genotyped in the report) and an unaffected sister who carries the other variant, c.560T>C.
